notes.title: Free copies as a thank you to our customers
notes.notes:
We are a little behind the curve on this announcement because we wanted to be sure everyone got their free copies first - be terrible if we announced and you didn't have them! Anyway, we appreciate that the best way to enjoy Backgammon is with friends, which is why we have gifted each of you two free copies to give away and help build a community. 

Nomad Games on behalf of Voofoo Studios

notes.title: Help break a record this weekend!
notes.notes: This Easter weekend you can play Backgammon Blitz for free on Steam to help us set a world record for the number of backgammon games played over 1 weekend. Players simply install the game and play between Friday 2pm (PST) – Sunday 2pm (PST) to count as part of the record attempt.

notes.title: World Record Attempt
notes.notes:
Help us set a Backgammon world record this weekend!

We're giving a free copy of Backgammon Blitz to everyone on Steam this Easter weekend to help us set a world record for the number of backgammon games played over 1 weekend. Players simply install the game and play between Friday 2pm (PST) – Sunday 2pm (PST) to count as part of the record attempt.

Everyone who tweets about the record attempt will also be entered into a prize draw to win a limited edition print by Alexandra Lllewellyn, the famous Backgammon board designer. Make sure you include #BackgammonFW in your tweet. Good luck!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/395900/

Backgammon Blitz will also be 50% off until Sunday April 3rd for those who like to play for keeps!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Backgammon Blitz, 25% off!
notes.notes:
Backgammon Blitz is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

Loved by millions, played for centuries, backgammon is a two-player strategy game quite unlike any other. The goal is simple: race to get your checkers off the board first. The deceptively deep rules and rhythm of backgammon has secured it as a favourite among casual and veteran players alike.

*Offer ends November 19 at 10AM Pacific Time
